summary: Iteration 10 — Google Maps integration verified on the mobile app. BACKEND (curl-verified): GET /api/maps/status -> {configured:true}; GET /api/maps/autocomplete?input=Powai and input=Bandra return real Google Places suggestions (5 each, Mumbai-focused, includedRegionCodes=[in]); GET /api/customer/orders/6a898ffb579bf734d81b162b/tracking returns active EN_ROUTE order with destination(19.1197,72.9089 'Hiranandani Site — Powai Mumbai'), mixer location(19.076,72.8777 at 2026-08-22T12:03:08Z), tm_number 'TSTESTF5F351', driver 'Suresh Driver' (+919000000002), route=null (Routes API disabled — graceful); GET /api/maps/route returns {configured:true} with no route fields (no error). FRONTEND (Expo web preview, 390x844): (A) ADDRESS AUTOCOMPLETE — Customer +919000000001 logs in via auto-filled dev_otp -> /new-order. Selecting plant, typing 'Powai' in [data-testid=neworder-address] renders a real Google Places dropdown with 5 suggestions (testIDs suggest-ChIJQ3sd... etc). Tapping the first suggestion fills the field with 'Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India' and shows the 'Location pinned on map' hint. Backend call GET /api/maps/place/{id} succeeds and coords are set. FULLY WORKING. (B) LIVE TRACKING — /track/6a898ffb579bf734d81b162b renders header, order info card (Destination, Transit Mixer TSTESTF5F351, Driver Suresh Driver, Mixer location 19.07600, 72.87770, Last GPS update 12:03:08 PM), EN ROUTE badge, and Call Driver button (data-testid=track-call-driver). 'Live ETA' and 'Distance to site' cards correctly ABSENT (route:null from backend). Screen does NOT crash — matches graceful state expectation. HOWEVER, the actual Google Map does NOT render on the Expo web preview: the map area displays the plain-text error "React Native WebView does not support this platform." — this is because LiveMap.tsx uses <WebView> from react-native-webview which has no web implementation. On mobile (Expo Go / native builds) this will work; on the web preview users see no map. The [data-testid=live-map] element count is 0 on web. (C) REGRESSION — /customer/orders lists 12 orders including the EN_ROUTE RMC-1012 tied to the tracked order id. No 5xx, no red-screen. Only console noise is the pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings (carried over from iterations 6-9).

ui_bugs.issue: On the Expo web preview the WebView renders the string 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' instead of a Google map. Because the current LiveMap.tsx unconditionally uses <WebView>, [data-testid=live-map] renders 0 elements on web and no mixer/site markers or polyline are visible. Info card, header, ETA/distance graceful-hide, and Call Driver still work — but the map itself is missing on web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LiveMap.tsx:66-75. Fix: add a Platform.OS === 'web' branch that renders an <iframe srcDoc={html}> (or use @react-google-maps/api) so the same testID and layout apply on web. Native (Expo Go / iOS / Android) will keep using WebView.

The static 'Maps: not configured' warning chip is hard-coded inside MapPlaceholder and shows even when EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY IS configured but the caller lacks lat/lng (e.g. small home 'Active Delivery' preview). Misleading UX — user sees 'Maps: not configured' on a screen where maps ARE configured but not needed. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ui/MapPlaceholder.tsx:56-61. Fix: relabel to 'Preview' or hide the chip when process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY is set.

integration_issues.flow: Live Tracking → Google Maps rendering on web
integration_issues.issue: react-native-webview 13.15.0 does not support the web platform, so LiveMap fails to render on Expo web preview. Address autocomplete (via backend proxy) works because it does not depend on the JS Maps API in the client.

react_native_issues.issue: LiveMap.tsx uses <WebView> from react-native-webview which has no web platform implementation and prints 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' Because Expo Router is served on the web preview, this makes the map unusable there. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/LiveMap.tsx:66-75. Recommendation: fork by Platform.OS — on web render an <iframe srcDoc={html}> directly (or migrate to @react-google-maps/api).

Console still emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'. Same as iterations 6-9. No user impact but should be cleaned up in the shared UI primitives.

action_items: HIGH — Update /app/frontend/src/components/LiveMap.tsx to render the map on Platform.OS==='web' using an <iframe srcDoc={html}> (keep testID='live-map') so the map is visible on the Expo web preview. On native, keep using react-native-webview WebView. This is the ONLY blocker for the review request's Live Tracking scenario.

LOW — Relabel or conditionally hide the 'Maps: not configured' chip in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/MapPlaceholder.tsx when EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY is set. Right now the customer home Active Delivery preview says 'Maps: not configured' even though maps ARE configured (only lat/lng is missing for that mini preview).

OPTIONAL — Migrate deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents style props in shared UI primitives (Card/Button/Skeleton) to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings. Carryover from iterations 6-9.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/maps.py — clean server-side key handling; autocomplete/place/status/route all return {configured:false} or graceful empty payloads when GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY is unset. compute_route swallows exceptions and returns None so /route always returns 200 with {configured:true} when Routes API is disabled — matches the graceful spec. Good.

frontend/app/new-order.tsx:65-77 — 350ms debounce for autocomplete, cancels on unmount, session_token generated once via useMemo, and setSuggestions([]) short-circuits when input < 3 chars. pickedRef prevents an autocomplete re-fire immediately after tapping a suggestion. Solid.

frontend/app/track/[id].tsx — Polls /tracking every 15s only when data.active is true, correctly hides Live ETA/Distance cards when data.route is null, renders Call Driver only when data.active && data.driver_mobile. Info card + graceful state work as spec'd.

frontend/src/components/LiveMap.tsx:66-75 — issue described in ui_bugs above. The canRender guard is correct (needs key + destination lat/lng) but the WebView branch does not have a web implementation. Suggested fix inline.

frontend/src/components/ui/MapPlaceholder.tsx:56-61 — the 'Maps: not configured' chip is hard-coded and shows even when the key IS set but the caller lacks coords. Consider passing a `configured` prop or reading process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY here.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of missing map on web: LiveMap.tsx line 66 renders <WebView> from react-native-webview unconditionally. react-native-webview has no browser implementation (13.15.0 prints the fallback string 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.'). Because Expo web is the current preview/testing surface, the map cannot render there. Mitigation: fork by Platform.OS — on 'web' render <iframe srcDoc={html} style={{border:0, width:'100%', height:'100%'}} data-testid='live-map' /> and on native keep the existing WebView. This preserves the same testID, styling, and (Maps JS) rendering. Reproduction: login as customer +919000000001, open /track/6a898ffb579bf734d81b162b in a browser (Expo web preview) — the map area shows the fallback string instead of a Google map.
